name: token-vault
description: Use named credentials through short-lived, one-use links and run real CLI commands without placing durable tokens in MCP messages.

interface.shortDescription: 私有凭据与一次性领取
interface.longDescription: Connect your own Token Vault. Agents request one-use links, receive credentials directly in command processes, and run actual CLIs. Supports direct credential upload from process environments. Requires a connected vault and a terminal-capable agent.
interface.defaultPrompt: 使用 Token Vault 列出凭据，为我授权的 CLI 任务申请一次性链接；不要把长期 Token 放进对话或工具参数。
